title: The Data Debt of Stockouts: Partial Identification and Minimax-Regret Inventory Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.19323v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Problem definition: Inventory decisions select which demand enters sales logs. Unrecorded forecasts can leave demand frequencies unidentified even when stocking levels are recorded. We study which multistage ordering decisions these logs can justify and what finite samples can guarantee.   Methodology/results: Nested stockout thresholds yield exact sets of compatible demand laws and finite representations for policy evaluation. We choose one deterministic inventory rule to minimize its largest expected cost gap from the informed optimum under the same law. This population value is data debt for the specified information and policy class. Under independent demand, carryover can create positive debt despite common optimal actions in every isolated period. Finite samples add learning error above debt. The required sample count grows linearly with the selection bound, with upper and lower orders matching up to logarithmic factors. This rate

translated_title: 缺货的数据债务：部分识别与极小极大遗憾库存控制
translated_abstract: 问题定义：库存决策决定了哪些需求能够进入销售日志。即使库存水平被完整记录，未被记录的预测信息也可能导致需求频率无法被识别。本文研究这些销售日志能够支持哪些多阶段订货决策，以及有限样本能够提供何种保证。方法/结果：嵌套的缺货阈值产生了精确的兼容需求法则集合以及用于策略评估的有限表示。我们选择一个确定性库存规则，使其在同一需求法则下相对于“知情最优解”的最大期望成本差距最小化。这一总体层面的数值即为特定信息和策略类别下的“数据债务”。在独立需求条件下，尽管每个孤立周期的最优订货行动相同，库存结转仍可能产生正的数据债务。有限样本会在数据债务之上额外引入学习误差。所需样本量随选择界限线性增长，其上下界阶数在对数因子范围内匹配。
tldr: 该论文提出“数据债务”这一新概念，用以量化缺货导致需求被截断记录时库存控制策略的固有性能损失，并通过部分识别与极小极大遗憾框架刻画了兼容需求法则的精确集合，以及样本复杂度随选择界限线性增长的保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of "data debt" to quantify the intrinsic performance loss of inventory control caused by stockout-censored demand data, and develops a partial identification and minimax-regret framework that characterizes exact sets of compatible demand laws and proves sample complexity growing linearly with the selection bound.
